description: Publishes a selected-field snapshot of Good Standing and Delinquent records from the official Business Entities in Colorado dataset, preserving source-specific status, entity ID, principal-office address, formation profile, provenance, and explicit non-site semantics.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects and accept only HTTPS requests to the exact data.colorado.gov metadata and 4ykn-tg5h JSON resource paths.
retry: Retry HTTP 429, 5xx, and transient transport failures with bounded exponential backoff. Do not retry redirects, other 4xx responses, schema drift, duplicate identity, source refresh drift, count mismatch, or quality-gate failures.
checkpoint: The selected-field source snapshot is acquired in strictly increasing entity-ID order and hashed before normalization. Source metadata and the selected-status count are rechecked before publication. A complete staged source snapshot can be revalidated and normalized into a new immutable run without reacquisition, and a complete unpublished manifest can be independently verified and published by immutable run ID. current.json changes only after complete run-scoped publication.
idempotency: The source rowsUpdatedAt timestamp plus SHA-256 of the ordered selected-field source artifact identify a source release; the Colorado entity ID creates a stable provisional organization candidate.
cancellation: Abort network requests and local record processing cooperatively, close partition streams, retain unpublished run-scoped staging for diagnosis, and do not change current.json.
retention_profile: Retain immutable internal selected-field source snapshots and approved public normalized releases until an approved retention operation removes them.
